name: @waste/api
description: The Hono API: the only web boundary to domain data (ADR-0001). GET /healthz (liveness), GET /readyz (readiness: the database answers within two seconds, or 503), GET /openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1 through hono-openapi, bearer security declared), GET /me (the caller as resolved for the request), the Organisation & Access resources: /company, /projects, /service-providers, /users (invite, change, deactivate, reactivate) and /roles with their grant matrix, and the Registry's: /waste-fractions, /container-types, /service-frequencies, /products, /customers, /properties, /property-groups and /shared-collection-points with the sets that travel with them, and the effective-dated /agreements with their subscriptions and /containers with their service placements, read as of a day with ?validOn=; the container ledger's commands, /containers/:id/receive, /return, /transfer, /decommission and /adjust, the placement create being the issue, each appending one Stock Movement and writing or ending the placement in the same transaction, with /containers/:id/movements and /stock-movements as the reads; Execution's office (Issue #104): /routes with its commands assign, dispatch, reschedule, cancel and the pickup order and /routes/:id/commands as the route's receipt log, /pickups with remove and correct-outcome, the live read /routes/live with /sessions, and /unloads with the office's capture on a route, every change writing its outbox event in the same transaction; and the driver door of ADR-0004: /driver/me, /driver/routes and /driver/routes/:id bounded by the assignment, POST /driver/commands applying a device's queued commands in savepoints with a receipt per command and a replay for an id already received, and /driver/commands as the receipts; and Resolution's (Issue #109): /tickets with its seven commands assign, start, wait, hold, complete, reject and reopen, /tickets/:id/events as the case's appended history and /tickets/:id/comments appending to it, GET /tickets?customerId= as the citizen portal's read, and /alerts with acknowledge, resolve and link-ticket, every ticket opened, completed or rejected writing its outbox event in the same transaction; and Finance & Contracting's (Issue #112): /price-lists with their rows and GET /price-lists/:id/resolve as the resolver's read, /service-areas with their planning-area and waste-fraction sets and their assignments (/service-area-assignments), /service-provider-prices with the index command that writes the next row of the chain, /billable-events with reprice and cancel, /billing-runs with the preview and the synchronous run that issues one invoice per payer and currency, /invoices with the credit note under an invoice, /settlements with calculate, close and reopen and /settlements/:id/events as the history, and weight control over the unloads, /unloads/:id/approve, /reject and /correct with /unloads/:id/reviews, every invoice issued and every settlement closed writing its outbox event in the same transaction, and a service provider's account reaching its own assignments, areas, prices and settlements and nothing else here. Lists are paged by a cursor over their time-ordered ids, which the server mints; a project-scoped route is bounded by the projects the caller works in as well as by the tenant. Supabase access tokens verified against the project's JWKS (jose), the caller's account and grants resolved inside a fenced transaction per request, every error an RFC 9457 problem. An environment parsed once at startup, DATABASE_URL and SUPABASE_URL required. Connects as the API role through @waste/db. Runs TypeScript source through tsx, like every workspace package, until hosting decides on bundling.
